review_finding_precision.basis: The report's own findings digest states 'Blocking precision: 0 adjudicated-confirmed / 1 raised, adjudication unknown' -- this describes SR1-F1 itself (the one blocking finding this round raised), still UNRESOLVED/unadjudicated at the time this report was written (2026-10-02), not an earlier round's findings being re-assessed. This record, written 2026-10-04 with the benefit of what actually happened afterward, credits SR1-F1 as CONFIRMED_FIXED, binding that credit directly to its recording artifact: .phase9-review/transition94-security/report.md (Security Reviewer /root/transition430_security, reviewing MR !24's delta to final head 94f0b8406ad377de3c5cdbbdcfb618abc00a6731) states verbatim under Dispositions: 'SR1-F1: CONFIRMED_FIXED for preparation defects, with remaining provenance component closed by Scott's explicit accepted admission.' That disposition itself rests on the companion phase9-ci-policy-transition Task Contract/evidence pack SR1-F1 required having been built and having received its own ordered re-review (see review_disagreement_and_revision_outcomes below) -- the same retrospective-crediting method case-study-zero (metrics/observations/phase8-layer3-git-trust-hardening.json) already used for its own findings. n=1 -- report as insufficient sample per definitions.md's small-samples rule, not as a stable rate; MIN_SPECIALTY_SAMPLE in verification/agent_routing_check.py is 1, so this is the minimum admissible population, not a comfortable one. model_identifier 'gpt-5.6-sol' is recorded here on Scott Wofford's direct confirmation as the human who installed, configured, and selected that exact model for this Codex deployment (2026-10-04) -- the review report itself explicitly disclaims this identity ('Model backend identity unavailable, not inferred'), consistent with every other Codex-authored review report produced this session, none of which self-report backend model identity. This is a human-attested fact recorded as such, not inferred by this record's collector and not claimed by the reviewer's own tooling.

Re-review the missing prerequisites when supplied') -- this was not optional and did occur. re_review_rounds: 2 counts exactly one Verifier pass (/root/transition430_clean_verifier, PASS_WITH_ADVISORIES) plus one Security pass (/root/transition430_security, PASS_WITH_ADVISORIES), both over MR !24 (codex/phase9-ci-policy-transition) at head 43014b1764471d1fe9168acb729b3a257c51dc2b -- the ordered, distinct pair that first confirmed the companion artifacts existed and narrowed SR1-F1 to its protected-provenance component (.phase9-review/transition430-clean-verifier/report.md, .phase9-review/transition430-security/report.md). This pair is distinct from both (a) the single SR1 review pass this record's own population is about, and (b) the later confirmatory pass (same Security Reviewer instance, reviewing the further delta to final head 94f0b8406ad377de3c5cdbbdcfb618abc00a6731) that actually delivered SR1-F1's CONFIRMED_FIXED disposition after Scott Wofford's explicit acceptance (.phase9-review/transition94-security/report.md, cited directly in review_finding_precision's basis above) -- not double-counted here as a third re-review round, since it confirms activation documentation rather than re-reviewing the companion artifacts themselves.
